input: common design patterns for building LLM agents

output.brief:
Final brief
- **Prompt Chaining**: Sequentially chaining prompts to guide the LLM through a series of tasks or decisions. ([Source](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents))
- **Routing**: Directing LLMs to different processes or tools based on context or input. ([Source](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents))
- **Parallelization**: Executing multiple processes or tasks simultaneously to improve efficiency. ([Source](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents))
- **Orchestrator-Workers**: An orchestrator manages and coordinates actions of multiple workers, each performing specific tasks. ([Source](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents))
- **Evaluator-Optimizer**: Evaluating LLM output and optimizing the process based on evaluation results. ([Source](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents))
